$meta.name: Travel app design tokens: sprint 11 additions
$meta.status: Proposal for Raz (docs/design/sprint-11/README.md section 31). Additions only, nothing changed or removed. No new colour value: every hex below already exists in tokens.json 0.11.0.
color.places.curatedTag.map: No new colours. 'Curated for Israelis' tag: status.info.subtleBg / subtleFg (StatusChip info), no icon. Deliberately not status.success: green would read as 'safe'. The label is allowed only next to a source and a verification date (README 5.1, 5.3).
color.places.bookmark.map: Not saved: outline in text.secondary. Saved: filled with action.primary.bg (both themes). State also in accessibilityState.selected (README 4).
color.tabs.map: Active tab: text and 3dp indicator in action.primary.bg. Inactive: text.secondary. Bottom hairline border.subtle. Tab bar background bg.canvas (README 3.3).
color.places.chip.map: Selected category chip: action.secondary.bg / fg with CheckIcon 16. Unselected: transparent with border.control (README 3.5).
color.itinerary.label.map: Day labels (landing, take-off, travelling, rest): bg.tag + text.secondary, never a warning colour. 'Today': status.success.subtleBg / subtleFg (as the hotel 'now' tag). 'Auto' tag on an activity: bg.tag + text.secondary with WandIcon 12 (README 9.3, 9.4).
color.itinerary.dayHeader.map: Sticky day header: bg.canvas with a border.subtle bottom hairline, so it covers rows scrolling under it. In-transit day: the whole header text in text.secondary (README 9.2).
color.itinerary.outOfRange.map: Section header in text.primary with WarningIcon 16 in entry.restricted.fg. Not red: nothing was lost (README 13).
color.planner.result.map: AutoPlanResult is an InlineNotice: status.info.subtleBg / subtleFg with WandIcon and a close button (README 11.3).
color.mapPicker.note: The pin is color.light.action.cta.bg in both themes because the map style is streets-v12 (light) in both themes (D9). White 2dp stroke and elevation.2 shadow. centerDot = color.light.text.primary. 4.2:1 against typical light street map land (graphic, needs 3:1) (README 8.2, 31.2).
color.admin.placeStatus.map: Draft: bg.tag + text.secondary (6.77). Published: status.success.subtleBg / subtleFg (6.33). Hidden: status.info.subtleBg / subtleFg (7.76). Not action.disabled for Hidden: 4.37:1 fails AA at 12px (README 23.2).
size.note: chip values equal size.discover.chip.* (one chip size in the app). All touch targets 48 (size.touchTarget.min). At font scale 2 the PlaceRow actions wrap to their own line and the ActivityRow time moves above the title (README 4, 9.4).
layout.mapPicker.note: Initial camera: existing point (zoom.point), else the first trip city with coordinates (zoom.city), else the country climate point (zoom.country). No user location, no geocoding. Accessibility nudge = half the visible width. Mapbox logo and attribution always visible above the bottom panel (README 8.2).
limits.sprint11.note: Counted in code points after trim (limits.note). Enforced in the RPCs and CHECKs; the UI only shows the line and the server error (README 5.2, 9.5, 12.2, 23.3).
places.distance.note: Under 1 km: metres rounded to 50. 1 to 10 km: one decimal. 10 km and more: whole km. Straight-line (haversine) distance, said so in the place sheet (README 4, 5.1).
motion.sprint11.note: Reduced motion: indicator, crossfades, reorder, result card and planned items appear instantly; no pin lift or drop; bookmark fills without the pop; no drag scale. Opening the itinerary is never animated beyond the modal slide and scrolling to today is instant. Saved / moved rows reuse motion.tripSaved.* (README 27).
rules.sprint11.note: NOT tokens (business rules, next to planTrip / itineraryDays / cityFor and the shared validators; sprint-11.md D14, D16, ch2, ch3): city radius 15 km; same-day grouping up to 10 km when possible; slots 09:30, 15:30, 19:00; relaxed 2, intense 3 per day; first day landing <12:00 up to 3 (2 relaxed), 12:00-18:00 up to 2, >18:00 none; last day take-off <14:00 airport only, >=14:00 one activity ending 4 h before take-off then airport; long flight > 8 h from first take-off to last landing outbound = rest day; tropical = hot band (t >= 24, discover.ts) in that day's month in that night's city, no outdoor 12:00-15:00; outdoor = attractions, nature, families; planner max 60 days; 60 places per country, 20 per each of the 5 largest cities.
